text: In the ADM formalism the tensor K_ij = −(1/2α)(∂_t γ_ij − 𝓛_β γ_ij), which measures how the spatial slice Σ_t curves within the surrounding four-dimensional spacetime and is the momentum conjugate to γ_ij, is the:
choices: intrinsic Ricci scalar ³R of the slice
explanation: The book identifies K_ij as the extrinsic curvature — how the spatial slice bends in the surrounding spacetime — and calls it the conjugate momentum to γ_ij. The intrinsic curvature ³R is built from γ_ij alone on the slice; α and βⁱ are gauge variables that carry no physical degrees of freedom.
